// PROBE (never compiled): loads that carry users.password without naming it.
// Kept red so rules (c) and (d) of password-column-never-loaded-outside-auth
// are proven to bite. The commented-out load below must NOT count.
export async function probe(db: any, id: string) {
    // const ghost = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id } })
    const full = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id } })
    const withRelation = await db.user.findMany({ where: { roles: { contains: "agent" } }, include: { policiesOwned: true } })
    const narrow = await db.user.findFirst({ where: { id }, select: { id: true, email: true } })
    const rel = await db.customerRelationship.findFirst({
        where: { policyholderUserId: id },
        include: { customer: true },
    })
    const portal = await db.customerRelationship.findFirst({
        where: { policyholderUserId: id },
        include: { agent: { include: { agentProfile: true } } },
    })
    const fine = await db.customerRelationship.findFirst({
        where: { policyholderUserId: id },
        include: { agent: { select: { id: true, name: true } } },
    })
    return { full, withRelation, narrow, rel, portal, fine }
}
